items.source: NOTE: This is an initial class reference as declared in the bean metadata definition, potentially combined with a declared factory method or a FactoryBean which may lead to a different runtime type of the bean, or not being set at all in case of an instance-level factory method (which is resolved via getFactoryBeanName() instead). Do not use this for runtime type introspection of arbitrary bean definitions. The recommended way to find out about the actual runtime type of a particular bean is a BeanFactory.getType(String) call for the specified bean name; this takes all of the above cases into account and returns the type of object that a BeanFactory.getBean(String) call is going to return for the same bean name.
items.translation: 注意： 这是作为 Bean 元数据定义中声明的初始类引用，可能会与声明的工厂方法或FactoryBean结合使用，从而导致 Bean 的实际运行时类型不同，或者在实例级工厂方法的情况下（该方法通过getFactoryBeanName()解析）根本未设置。 请勿将此用于任意 Bean 定义的运行时类型检查。 了解特定 Bean 实际运行时类型的推荐方法是针对指定的 Bean 名称调用BeanFactory.getType(String)；此方法会考虑上述所有情况，并返回与相同 Bean 名称的BeanFactory.getBean(String)调用将返回的对象类型。

items.source: The default value is true for a locally specified init method but switched to false for a shared setting in a defaults section (for example, bean init-method versus beans default-init-method level in XML) which might not apply to all contained bean definitions.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`（针对本地指定的初始化方法），但在 defaults 部分中的共享设置中会切换为 `false`（例如，XML 中的 `bean init-method` 与 `beans default-init-method` 级别），后者可能不适用于所有包含的 bean 定义。

items.source: The default value is true for a locally specified destroy method but switched to false for a shared setting in a defaults section (for example, bean destroy-method versus beans default-destroy-method level in XML) which might not apply to all contained bean definitions.
items.translation: 默认值为本地指定的销毁方法时是true，但在 defaults 部分中切换为共享设置时为false（例如，XML 中的bean destroy-method与beans default-destroy-method级别），后者可能不适用于所有包含的 bean 定义。

items.source: Set this flag to true to allow for instantiating this bean on a background thread. For a non-lazy singleton, a background pre-instantiation thread can be used then, while still enforcing the completion at the end of DefaultListableBeanFactory.preInstantiateSingletons(). For a lazy singleton, a background pre-instantiation thread can be used as well - with completion allowed at a later point, enforcing it when actually accessed.
items.translation: 将此标志设置为 `true` 以允许在后台线程中实例化此 Bean。对于非懒加载的单例，此时可以使用后台预实例化线程，同时仍强制在 DefaultListableBeanFactory.preInstantiateSingletons() 结束时完成。对于懒加载单例，也可以使用后台预实例化线程——允许稍后完成，并在实际访问时强制执行。

items.source: The autowire constants match the ones defined in the AutowireCapableBeanFactory interface.
items.translation: autowire 常量与在 AutowireCapableBeanFactory 接口中定义的常量相匹配。

items.source: The attribute value may be a single Constructor reference or an array thereof.
items.translation: 属性值可以是单个Constructor引用，或者是该引用的数组。

items.source: This implementation delegates to getBeanClass().
items.translation: 此实现委托给getBeanClass()。

items.source: The default is SCOPE_DEFAULT.
items.translation: 默认值为SCOPE_DEFAULT。

items.source: The default is true, allowing injection by type at any injection point. Switch this to false in order to disable autowiring by type for this bean.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`，允许在任何注入点按类型进行注入。将此值切换为 `false` 可禁用此 Bean 的按类型自动装配。

items.source: The default is true, allowing injection by type at any injection point. Switch this to false in order to restrict injection by default, effectively enforcing an additional indication such as a qualifier match.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`，允许在任何注入点按类型进行注入。将其切换为 `false` 以限制默认的注入行为，从而强制要求额外的指示（例如限定符匹配）。

items.source: The default is singleton status, although this is only applied once a bean definition becomes active in the containing factory. A bean definition may eventually inherit its scope from a parent bean definition. For this reason, the default scope name is an empty string (i.e., ""), with singleton status being assumed until a resolved scope is set.
items.translation: 默认状态为单例，尽管该设置仅在包含工厂中的 Bean 定义变为活动状态时应用一次。Bean 定义最终可能会从其父 Bean 定义继承作用域。因此，默认的作用域名称为空字符串（即 `""`），在解析并设置作用域之前，假定其状态为单例。

items.source: The default is "false". Specify true to tell the bean factory to not try to instantiate that particular bean in any case.
items.translation: 默认值为"false"。指定true可指示 Bean 工厂在任何情况下都不要尝试实例化该特定 Bean。

items.source: Never returns null.
items.translation: 永不返回null。

items.source: The default is null in which case there are no initializer methods.
items.translation: 默认值为null，此时没有初始化方法。

items.source: The default is null in which case there is no initializer method.
items.translation: 默认值为null，此时没有初始化方法。

items.source: The default is null in which case there are no destroy methods.
items.translation: 默认值为null，此时没有销毁方法。

items.source: The default is null in which case there is no destroy method.
items.translation: 默认值为null，此时没有销毁方法。

items.source:
Currently, the method names detected during destroy method inference
are "close" and "shutdown", if present on the specific bean class.
items.translation: 当前，在销毁方法推断期间检测到的方法名称为"close"和"shutdown"（如果特定 Bean 类中存在这些方法）。

items.source:
Note that this flag may be ignored by bean factories not set up for
background bootstrapping, always applying single-threaded bootstrapping
for non-lazy singleton beans.
items.translation: 注意，对于未配置为后台引导的 Bean 工厂，此标志可能会被忽略，始终对非懒加载的单例 Bean 应用单线程引导。

items.source:
If such a callback is set, it will override any other constructor
or factory method metadata. However, bean property population and
potential annotation-driven injection will still apply as usual.
items.translation: 如果设置了此类回调，它将覆盖任何其他构造函数或工厂方法元数据。但是，Bean 属性填充和潜在的基于注解的注入仍将按常规方式应用。

items.source:
This applies to constructor resolution, factory method resolution,
and also init/destroy methods. Bean property accessors have to be public
in any case and are not affected by this setting.
items.translation: 这适用于构造器解析、工厂方法解析，以及初始化/销毁方法。Bean 属性访问器无论如何都必须是公开的，且不受此设置影响。

items.source:
Note that annotation-driven configuration will still access non-public
members as far as they have been annotated. This setting applies to
externalized metadata in this bean definition only.
items.translation: 注意，只要已添加注解，基于注解的配置仍将访问非公共成员。此设置仅适用于该 Bean 定义中的外部化元数据。

items.source: The returned instance can be modified during bean factory post-processing.
items.translation: 返回的实例可以在 Bean 工厂后处理期间被修改。

items.source:
Override settings in this bean definition (presumably a copied parent from a parent-child inheritance relationship) from the given bean definition (presumably the child).
  • Will override beanClass if specified in the given bean definition.
  • Will always take abstract, scope, lazyInit, autowireMode, dependencyCheck, and dependsOn from the given bean definition.
  • Will add constructorArgumentValues, propertyValues, methodOverrides from the given bean definition to existing ones.
  • Will override factoryBeanName, factoryMethodName, initMethodName, and destroyMethodName if specified in the given bean definition.
items.translation:
覆盖此 Bean 定义中的设置（假定是从父子继承关系中复制的父 Bean），来自给定的 Bean 定义（假定是子 Bean）。
  • 如果给定的 Bean 定义中指定了 beanClass，则将其覆盖。
  • 始终从给定的 Bean 定义中获取 abstract、scope、lazyInit、autowireMode、dependencyCheck 和 dependsOn。
  • 将给定的 Bean 定义中的 constructorArgumentValues、propertyValues 和 methodOverrides 添加到现有的设置中。
  • 如果给定的 Bean 定义中指定了 factoryBeanName、factoryMethodName、initMethodName 和 destroyMethodName，则将其覆盖。

items.source: The name of an attribute that can be set on a BeanDefinition so that bean definitions can indicate the sort order for the targeted bean. This is analogous to the @Order annotation.
items.translation: 一个属性的名称，该属性可以设置到BeanDefinition上（通过set），以便 bean 定义能够指示目标 bean 的排序顺序。这与@Order注解类似。

items.source: The name of an attribute that can be set on a BeanDefinition so that bean definitions can indicate the sort order for the targeted bean.
items.translation: 属性名称，可以在 `BeanDefinition` 上set，以便 bean 定义能够指示目标 bean 的排序顺序。

items.source: The name of an attribute that can be set on a BeanDefinition so that bean definitions can indicate one or more preferred constructors.
items.translation: 属性名称，可以在 `BeanDefinition` 上set，以便 bean 定义可以指示一个或多个首选构造函数。

items.source: Public declaration of Object's clone() method. Delegates to cloneBeanDefinition().
items.translation: Object 的 `clone()` 方法的公共声明。 委托给cloneBeanDefinition()。

items.source: Constant that indicates the container should attempt to infer the destroy method name for a bean as opposed to explicit specification of a method name.
items.translation: 指示容器尝试推断 Bean 的销毁方法名，而不是显式指定方法名的常量。

items.source: Constant for the default scope name: "", equivalent to singleton status unless overridden from a parent bean definition (if applicable).
items.translation: 默认作用域名称的常量：""，等效于单例（singleton）状态，除非从父级 Bean 定义中覆盖（如果适用）。

items.source: Return the bootstrap mode for this bean: default is false for using the main pre-instantiation thread for non-lazy singleton beans and the caller thread for prototype beans.
items.translation: 返回此 Bean 的 Bootstrap 模式：默认值为 `false`，表示使用主预实例化线程为非懒加载单例 Bean 服务，而使用调用者线程为原型 Bean 服务。

items.source: Specify whether to resolve constructors in lenient mode (true, which is the default) or to switch to strict resolution (throwing an exception in case of ambiguous constructors that all match when converting the arguments, whereas lenient mode would use the one with the 'closest' type matches).
items.translation: 指定是否以宽松模式（`true`，默认值）解析构造函数，还是切换到严格解析（在参数转换时所有构造函数均匹配但存在歧义的情况下抛出异常，而宽松模式会使用“最接近”的类型匹配的构造函数）。

items.source: Set whether this bean definition is 'synthetic', that is, not defined by the application itself (for example, an infrastructure bean such as a helper for auto-proxying, created through <aop:config>).
items.translation: 设置此 Bean 定义是否为“合成”的，即不是由应用程序本身定义的（例如，通过 `<aop:config>` 创建的用于自动代理的基础设施 Bean，如辅助器）。

items.source:
If you are using mixed autowiring strategies, use
annotation-based autowiring for clearer demarcation of autowiring needs.
items.translation: 如果您使用混合自动装配策略，请使用基于注解的自动装配以更清晰地界定自动装配需求。

items.translation: 指示自动装配构造函数的常量。

items.source: Constant that indicates no external autowiring at all.
items.translation: 指示完全不进行外部自动装配的常量。

items.source:
Constant that indicates dependency checking for all properties
(object references as well as "simple" properties).
items.translation: 指示对所有属性（包括对象引用和“简单”属性）进行依赖检查的常量。

items.source: Constant that indicates no dependency check at all.
items.translation: 表示完全不进行依赖检查的常量。

items.translation: 指示对象引用依赖检查的常量。

items.source: Constant that indicates dependency checking for "simple" properties.
items.translation: 指示对“简单”属性进行依赖检查的常量。

items.source: Create a new AbstractBeanDefinition with default settings.
items.translation: 创建一个新的具有默认设置的 AbstractBeanDefinition。

items.source:
Create a new AbstractBeanDefinition with the given

items.translation: 使用给定的构造函数参数值和属性值创建一个新的 AbstractBeanDefinition。

items.source:

items.translation: 创建一个新的 AbstractBeanDefinition 作为给定 bean definition 的深拷贝。

items.source:
Register a qualifier to be used for autowire candidate resolution,

items.translation: 注册一个用于自动注入候选解析的限定符，以限定符的类型名为键。

items.source: Apply the provided default values to this bean.
items.translation: 将此默认值应用于该 Bean。

items.source: Copy the qualifiers from the supplied AbstractBeanDefinition to this bean definition.
items.translation: 从提供的 AbstractBeanDefinition 复制限定符到此 BeanDefinition。

items.translation: 返回 BeanDefinition 中指定的自动装配模式。

items.translation: 返回依赖检查代码。

items.source: Return the names of the destroy methods.
items.translation: 返回销毁方法的名称。

items.source: Return a factory method, if any.
items.translation: 返回工厂方法（如果有）。

items.source: Return the names of the initializer methods.
items.translation: 返回初始化方法的名称。

items.source: Return a callback for creating an instance of the bean, if any.
items.translation: 返回用于创建 Bean 实例的回调（如果有）。

items.source: Return whether this bean should be lazily initialized, i.e.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 是否应延迟初始化，即

items.translation: 返回与提供的类型名映射的限定符。

items.translation: 返回所有已注册的限定符。

items.source:
Return the resolved autowire code,
(resolving AUTOWIRE_AUTODETECT to AUTOWIRE_CONSTRUCTOR or AUTOWIRE_BY_TYPE).
items.translation: 返回解析后的自动注入代码，（将 `AUTOWIRE_AUTODETECT` 解析为 `AUTOWIRE_CONSTRUCTOR` 或 `AUTOWIRE_BY_TYPE`）。

items.source: Return the resource that this bean definition came from.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 定义来源的资源。

items.source:
Return a description of the resource that this bean definition
came from (for the purpose of showing context in case of errors).
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 定义来源资源的描述（用于在出现错误时显示上下文）。

items.source: Return whether this definition specifies a bean class.
items.translation: 返回该定义是否指定了 Bean 类。

items.source: Return if there are constructor argument values defined for this bean.
items.translation: 如果为此 Bean 定义了构造函数参数值，则返回。

items.source: Return if there are method overrides defined for this bean.
items.translation: 如果为此 Bean 定义了方法覆盖，则返回。

items.source: Return if there are property values defined for this bean.
items.translation: 如果该 Bean 定义了属性值，则返回。

items.source: Return whether this bean has the specified qualifier.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 是否具有指定的限定符。

items.source: Indicate whether the configured destroy method is the default.
items.translation: 指明配置的销毁方法是否为默认方法。

items.source: Indicate whether the configured initializer method is the default.
items.translation: 指示配置的初始化方法是否为默认方法。

items.source: Return whether to resolve constructors in lenient mode or in strict mode.
items.translation: 返回是否以宽松模式或严格模式解析构造函数。

items.source: Return whether to allow access to non-public constructors and methods.
items.translation: 返回是否允许访问非公共构造函数和方法。

items.source:
Return whether this bean definition is 'synthetic', that is,
not defined by the application itself.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 定义是否为“合成”的，即是否不是由应用程序本身定义的。

items.source: Specify the class for this bean.
items.translation: 指定该 Bean 的类。

items.source: Specify constructor argument values for this bean.
items.translation: 为此 Bean 指定构造函数参数值。

items.source: Set the dependency check code.
items.translation: 设置依赖检查代码。

items.source: Specify method overrides for the bean, if any.
items.translation: 为 Bean 指定方法覆盖（如有）。

items.source: Set the originating (for example, decorated) BeanDefinition, if any.
items.translation: 设置源（例如，装饰过的）BeanDefinition（如果有）。

items.source: Specify property values for this bean, if any.
items.translation: 为此 Bean 指定属性值（如有）。

items.source:
Set the resource that this bean definition came from
(for the purpose of showing context in case of errors).
items.translation: 设置此 Bean 定义来源的资源（用于在发生错误时显示上下文）。

items.source:
Set a description of the resource that this bean definition
came from (for the purpose of showing context in case of errors).
items.translation: 设置该 Bean 定义来源资源的描述（用于在出现错误时显示上下文）。

items.source: Validate this bean definition.
items.translation: 验证此 Bean 定义。

items.source:
Determine the class of the wrapped bean, resolving it from a
specified class name if necessary. Will also reload a specified
Class from its name when called with the bean class already resolved.
items.translation: 确定包装 Bean 的类，必要时从指定的类名解析它。当使用已解析的 Bean 类调用时，也会从其名称重新加载指定的 Class。

items.source:
Set the autowire mode. This determines whether any automagical detection
and setting of bean references will happen. The default is AUTOWIRE_NO
which means there won't be convention-based autowiring by name or type
(however, there may still be explicit annotation-driven autowiring).
items.translation: 设置自动线束模式。此选项决定是否会进行任何神奇的 Bean 引用检测和设置。默认值为 AUTOWIRE_NO，这意味着不会基于名称或类型的约定进行自动线束（不过，仍可能存在显式的注解驱动的自动线束）。

items.source:
Validate and prepare the method overrides defined for this bean.
Checks for existence of a method with the specified name.
items.translation: 验证并准备为此 Bean 定义的方法重写。检查是否存在具有指定名称的方法。

items.source:
Validate and prepare the given method override.
Checks for existence of a method with the specified name,
marking it as not overloaded if none found.
items.translation: 验证并准备给定的方法重写。检查是否存在指定名称的方法，若未找到则将其标记为未重载。

items.source:
Clone this bean definition.
To be implemented by concrete subclasses.
items.translation: 克隆该 Bean 定义。由具体子类实现。

items.source: Note that this does not have to be the actual class name used at runtime, in case of a child definition overriding/inheriting the class name from its parent. Also, this may just be the class that a factory method is called on, or it may even be empty in case of a factory bean reference that a method is called on. Hence, do not consider this to be the definitive bean type at runtime but rather only use it for parsing purposes at the individual bean definition level.
items.translation: 请注意，在子定义覆盖或继承其父类的类名的情况下，这不必是运行时实际使用的真实类名。此外，这可能只是工厂方法被调用的类，或者在调用方法的工厂 Bean 引用为空时，它甚至可能是空的。因此，请勿将此视为运行时的最终 Bean 类型，而仅将其用于单个 Bean 定义级别的解析目的。

items.source: If false, the bean will get instantiated on startup by bean factories that perform eager initialization of singletons.
items.translation: 如果为false，则单例的 Bean 工厂将在启动时执行单例的急切初始化。

items.source: If this value is true for exactly one bean among multiple matching candidates, it will serve as a tie-breaker.
items.translation: 如果此值在多个匹配候选项中恰好对一个 Bean 为 `true`，它将作为决胜手段。

items.source: If this value is true for all beans but one among multiple matching candidates, the remaining bean will be selected.
items.translation: 如果此值在所有匹配候选项中除一个之外的所有 Bean 上都为 `true`，则选择剩余的 Bean。

items.source: This will be null for static factory methods which will be derived from the bean class instead.
items.translation: 这将对于从 Bean 类派生的静态工厂方法为 `null`。

items.source:
The class name can be modified during bean factory post-processing,
typically replacing the original class name with a parsed variant of it.
items.translation: 类名可以在 Bean 工厂后处理期间进行修改，通常是用其解析后的变体替换原始类名。

items.source:
This is typically fully resolved on a runtime-merged bean definition
but not necessarily on a configuration-time definition instance.
items.translation: 这通常在运行时合并的 Bean 定义上完全解析，但在配置时间定义实例上则不一定。

items.source:
Note that dependencies are normally expressed through bean properties or
constructor arguments. This property should just be necessary for other kinds
of dependencies like statics (*ugh*) or database preparation on startup.
items.translation: 请注意，依赖通常通过 Bean 属性或构造函数参数来表达。此属性应仅用于其他类型的依赖（例如静态类 [*ugh*]）或在启动时进行数据库准备。

items.source:
Note that this flag is designed to only affect type-based autowiring.
It does not affect explicit references by name, which will get resolved even
if the specified bean is not marked as an autowire candidate. As a consequence,
autowiring by name will nevertheless inject a bean if the name matches.
items.translation: 请注意，此标志仅影响基于类型的自动装配。它不会影响通过名称进行的显式引用；即使指定的 Bean 未标记为自动装配候选者，这些引用仍会被解析。因此，按名称进行自动装配时，只要名称匹配，就会注入一个 Bean。

items.source:
A factory bean name is only necessary for instance-based factory methods.
For static factory methods, the method will be derived from the bean class.
items.translation: 工厂 Bean 名称仅对基于实例的工厂方法而言是必需的。对于静态工厂方法，该方法将从 Bean 类中推导得出。
